search_titles.description: Search OMDb for films, series and episodes by name and return a page of matches. Each row carries an IMDb ID a later step can look up for the full record. A search that matches nothing returns no rows rather than failing.
search_titles.name: search_titles

parameters.description: The title to search for. OMDb refuses a term that matches too many titles, so prefer a distinctive one over a single common word.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. Only match a title released in this year - useful to tell remakes apart, for example 'Dune' in 1984 from 'Dune' in 2021.
parameters.name: year

parameters.description: Which page of results to return. OMDb serves ten per page and accepts pages 1-100, so the deepest result it will reach is the 1,000th.
parameters.name: page

has_more.description: Whether another page can be fetched. False on the last page and on page 100, which is as deep as OMDb serves.

result_count.description: How many rows are on this page (at most 10)

results.description: The matching titles, ten to a page, as OMDb ranks them

imdb_id.description: The title's IMDb ID, for example 'tt1375666'. Use it to look the title up again without re-searching.

imdb_url.description: Link to the title's page on imdb.com. Built from the IMDb ID - OMDb does not send it.
